subject: A sprint SEED — the drift-resistant intent artifact authored by the planter (objective, file_scope, acceptance, invariants) that grounds the whole sprint.

dimensions.desc: Objective + invariants are sharp enough that an agent hours in could not wander; scope is bounded.
file_scope paths look real (or marked NEW); acceptance is concrete and checkable, not aspirational.
Says what's needed and stops — no prescriptive Lane-N micromanagement, no padding the agent will ignore.
Zero deferred-content markers: no TBD/TODO, no 'add appropriate error handling', no 'similar to X', no reference to a file, issue, or symbol the seed never anchors.

guidance: Reward a seed that an engineer could turn into a plan with zero clarifying questions. Penalize hallucinated paths, vague acceptance ('make it better'), over-specification that usurps the engineer's planning job, and any placeholder that pushes authoring work onto the reader.
